ANALYTICAL ASSESSMENT
WHAT MATTERS

Overall maritime risk assessment is pending until coverage is complete. The assessment is concentrated on Iran. What matters operationally is whether another commercial-vessel attack occurs or a route disruption is reported; that assessment is distinct from the highest individual incident severity of High.

IMPLICATIONS FOR BUSINESS

Review passage plans and escalation triggers for Strait of Hormuz.

WATCH NEXT

Monitor Strait of Hormuz for a further commercial-vessel attack, a route disruption, or a commercial consequence.
